post.description:
Revokes nothing server-side beyond what a real jti-blacklist entry would
need the raw token for (the dependency only decodes+validates it, it
doesn't hand the jti back here) — clients should discard their tokens
client-side. Kept as a named endpoint for API symmetry / future
jti-revocation wiring rather than omitted entirely.

Mints a fresh, single-use, 15-minute QR-pairing code for this vehicle.
Encode the returned `code` in a QR code the device scans (or a staff member
keys in by hand) to drive `POST /v1/fleet/devices/register`.

Manual admin provisioning of a device row ahead of physical pairing.
Most devices arrive via `POST /devices/register` instead.

QR-pairing: the device presents its `android_id` plus the pairing code
shown/scanned from `POST /vehicles/{id}/pairing-code`, and is bound to that
code's vehicle. Requires auth like every endpoint here (the person setting
up the kiosk is logged into the app) — see the domain summary for why this
doesn't use a separate device-credential scheme.

Updates last_seen_at/battery/network and returns the current device row —
including `kiosk_locked` / `force_update_pending`, which is how the device
learns an admin has flagged it for kiosk-lock or a forced app update.

Admin-only. Sets/clears the kiosk_locked flag the device reads back on
its next heartbeat.

Admin-only. Sets/clears the force_update_pending flag the device reads
back on its next heartbeat.

get.description:
Resolves the tenant's currently-effective tariff for `region` at `at`
(defaults to now). NOTE: registered before `/{tariff_id}` so "active"
is never captured as a path parameter.

Returns the platform-wide (tenant_id IS NULL) Fares Order reference
tariff currently effective for `region`. 404s until the integration step
seeds the global reference rows — expected in isolation.

post.description: Opens a new shift, capturing the pre-shift inspection checklist.

Closes a shift: recomputes trips_count/km_total/cash_total/card_total by
aggregating the shift's own trips, and records the supplied reconciliation
figures (psl_owed, reconciled).

get.description:
JSON summary of the shift. TODO(reporting): PDF/CSV export — see
app.services.shift.build_report docstring; no PDF library in this pass.

parameters.name: active_only

schema.description: If true, only return shifts with end_at IS NULL.
schema.title: Active Only

parameters.description: If true, only return shifts with end_at IS NULL.

post.description:
Generic create for CRUD completeness/admin backfill. The normal path for
opening a shift is `POST /v1/shifts/start`.

schema.title: Response List Ledger Entries V1 Psl Ledger Get

post.description:
Records (and, with a real Stripe key configured, actually attempts) a debit
of the driver's card for a PSL top-up. Falls back to a mock charge when no
real Stripe key is configured (see app.services.psl_ledger.charge_driver_card).
On a successful charge, credits the period's ledger entry's amount_collected.

schema.title: Response List Topups V1 Psl Topups Get

post.description: Opens a duress event and starts its 10-second cancel window.

Cancels an event — only valid inside its cancel window (status must
still be `open` and the wall-clock deadline recorded at trigger time must
not have passed).

Advances the escalation cascade by one stage (cancel_window_expired ->
notify_dispatch -> sms_emergency_contacts -> present_000_call_script).
Resolves/closes an event.

Broadcasts a GPS fix to every dashboard listener currently connected to
`WS /v1/duress/{event_id}/live`. Not persisted (see
`app.services.duress.GPSBroadcaster`) — this is a live relay, not a store.

schema.title: Response Post Gps V1 Duress  Event Id  Gps Post

parameters.name: open_only

schema.description: If true, only return non-terminal (not resolved/cancelled) events.
schema.title: Open Only

parameters.description: If true, only return non-terminal (not resolved/cancelled) events.

post.description:
Generic create for CRUD completeness/admin backfill. The normal path for
opening an event is `POST /v1/duress/trigger`.

get.description:
Every vehicle's latest cached position for this tenant. In-memory
only — empty after a process restart until the next publish.

schema.title: Response List Positions V1 Fleet Positions Get

post.description:
Publishes one vehicle's current position/status: updates the in-memory
latest-position cache (enriches `GET /v1/vehicles`) and fans the update
out to every `WS /v1/fleet/live` listener currently connected for this
tenant. 404s if `vehicle_id` doesn't belong to the caller's tenant.

get.description:
The latest cached position for one vehicle. 404s if nothing has ever
been published for it (this endpoint does not fall back to trip data —
that richer fallback is what `GET /v1/vehicles/{vehicle_id}` is for).

delete.description:
Cancels rather than hard-deletes: DELETE transitions status to
"canceled" (and best-effort cancels the Stripe-side subscription) so the
row survives as billing history, matching the payments domain's
audit-trail convention.

post.description:
Multipart upload: saves the file under
`uploads/{tenant_id}/{vehicle_id}/` (created if missing) on local disk (no
S3 in this environment — matches the sibling captaindash project's
local-disk-upload convention) and stores the *relative* path on the row.

patch.description:
Corrections only (doc_type/notes) — the underlying file/vehicle/uploader
are not changeable through this endpoint; delete and re-upload instead.

get.description:
Cl.14-checklist summary of which required doc types are on file for this
vehicle and which are missing. NOTE: a real PDF render of this dossier is
out of scope for this pass — see the TODO on
`app.schemas.compliance.ComplianceDossierRead`.

post.description:
Any authenticated tenant user may write an audit entry. The entry
always records the CALLER (`get_current_user`) as `actor_user_id` — this
is not a client-supplied field on `AuditLogCreate`, precisely so a client
cannot forge an entry attributed to a different user.

Creates the job and immediately broadcasts a pending offer to every
currently-available driver (see module docstring). Returns the job alone
— `GET /{id}/offers` lists what was actually offered and to whom.

delete.description:
Admin/dispatcher only. Cancels a job and expires any outstanding
pending offers for it (see `app.services.jobs.cancel_job`). Returns the
cancelled job rather than 204, so the caller can see the final state
without a follow-up GET — kept as `DELETE` per the task brief's literal
endpoint list even though it's a soft-cancel, not a row deletion.

schema.title: Response List Job Offers V1 Jobs  Job Id  Offers Get

post.description:
A driver's own self-toggle — not in the task brief's literal endpoint
list, but the minimal write surface needed for the `is_available` half of
the matching rule (see `app.models.jobs.DriverAvailability`'s module
docstring) to be reachable/testable at all.

A `driver`-role caller always sends as themselves (their own id is
used as `driver_id`, ignoring anything in the body); every other role
sends as "dispatch" into the `driver_id` thread named in the body.

AuditLogCreate.title: AuditLogCreate
AuditLogCreate.description:
Body for `POST /v1/audit-log`. Note there is no `actor_user_id` field —
the endpoint always attributes the entry to the authenticated caller
(`get_current_user`); a client cannot forge another user as the actor.

ChecklistItemRead.title: ChecklistItemRead
ChecklistItemRead.description:
One line of the cl.14-derived checklist for a vehicle. `doc_types`
lists which `doc_type` value(s) satisfy this item — `tamper_measures` is a
composite of the three tamper-related registers (see
`app.services.compliance.CL14_CHECKLIST`).

ComplianceDocumentUpdate.title: ComplianceDocumentUpdate
ComplianceDocumentUpdate.description:
Partial update — every field optional. Corrections only (e.g. fixing a
mis-tagged doc_type or amending notes); the underlying file/vehicle/uploader
are not changeable — delete and re-upload instead.

ComplianceDossierRead.title: ComplianceDossierRead
ComplianceDossierRead.description:
Response for `GET /v1/compliance/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/dossier`.

TODO(compliance-vault): a real PDF render of this dossier (the artifact an
operator would actually hand to a P2P Commissioner inspector) is out of
scope for this pass — this endpoint returns the equivalent JSON summary
only. A follow-up should add a `GET .../dossier.pdf` variant.

DeviceRegisterRequest.title: DeviceRegisterRequest
DeviceRegisterRequest.description: What the device presents to bind itself to a vehicle via QR-pairing.

DeviceUpdate.title: DeviceUpdate
DeviceUpdate.description:
Partial update — every field optional. `android_id` is not changeable
after creation (it identifies the physical unit); re-pair via
`POST /v1/fleet/devices/register` instead.

DriverAvailabilityUpdate.title: DriverAvailabilityUpdate
DriverAvailabilityUpdate.description: Body for `POST /v1/jobs/availability` — a driver's own self-toggle.

vehicle_id.title: Vehicle Id
vehicle_id.description: Vehicle currently assigned via the open shift, if on_shift.

DriverLiveRead.title: DriverLiveRead
DriverLiveRead.description:
One row of `GET /v1/drivers` — a driver (`User` with role="driver",
owned by the user domain) with on-shift status joined in from the shift
domain. Read-only, same rationale as `VehicleLiveRead`.

DuressCancelRequest.title: DuressCancelRequest
DuressCancelRequest.description:
Body for `POST /v1/duress/{id}/cancel`. No fields required — reserved for
an optional operator note.

DuressEscalateRequest.title: DuressEscalateRequest
DuressEscalateRequest.description:
Body for `POST /v1/duress/{id}/escalate`. Each call advances exactly one
stage of the fixed cascade (see `app.models.duress.ESCALATION_STAGES`).

DuressEventCreate.title: DuressEventCreate
DuressEventCreate.description:
Generic create — accepted for CRUD completeness/admin backfill. The
normal path for opening an event is `POST /v1/duress/trigger` above.

DuressEventUpdate.title: DuressEventUpdate
DuressEventUpdate.description:
Partial update — every field optional. Intended for admin corrections
(e.g. fixing a mis-keyed reference), NOT for driving the state machine —
use `/cancel`, `/escalate`, `/close` for that.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: Device-reported fix time. Defaults to server time.

DuressGpsPoint.title: DuressGpsPoint
DuressGpsPoint.description:
Body for `POST /v1/duress/{id}/gps` — a single GPS fix, broadcast
verbatim (plus a server timestamp) to every connected `/live` websocket
listener for this event. Not persisted — see `app.services.duress.GPSBroadcaster`.

gps_stream_ref.title: Gps Stream Ref
gps_stream_ref.description: Reference to the live GPS trace for this event. If omitted, a default `duress/{event_id}/gps` reference is generated.

DuressTriggerRequest.title: DuressTriggerRequest
DuressTriggerRequest.description: Body for `POST /v1/duress/trigger` — opens a new duress event.

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: True when this row is synthesized, not read from live Stripe.

JobCreate.title: JobCreate
JobCreate.description:
Body for `POST /v1/jobs` — a new ride request. `status`, `requested_at`,
`created_by_user_id` are all server-assigned, never client-supplied.

ManualPaymentRequest.title: ManualPaymentRequest
ManualPaymentRequest.description:
CabCharge/TTSS docket entry — Phase 1 is manual entry, no live rail
integration.

MessageCreate.title: MessageCreate
MessageCreate.description:
Body for `POST /v1/messages`. `driver_id` identifies whose thread the
message belongs to — required for dispatch-side senders (owner/admin/
dispatcher); ignored (and replaced with the caller's own id) for a
`driver`-role sender. See `app.api.v1.messages`'s module docstring.

PSLLedgerUpdate.title: PSLLedgerUpdate
PSLLedgerUpdate.description: Partial update — e.g. correcting an accrual or marking a period remitted.

PairingCodeRead.title: PairingCodeRead
PairingCodeRead.description:
Response for `POST /v1/fleet/vehicles/{id}/pairing-code` — encode this
(or a QR of it) for the device to scan/enter.

PaymentUpdate.title: PaymentUpdate
PaymentUpdate.description:
Partial update. amount/surcharge/method/trip_id are immutable after
creation (financial audit trail) — only status transitions (typically
webhook-driven), the Stripe reference, and free-text notes/docket
corrections are patchable.

PositionPublishRequest.title: PositionPublishRequest
PositionPublishRequest.description:
Body for `POST /v1/fleet/positions` — a device/tick handler's position
report for one vehicle. Not persisted to the database (see
`app.services.live_ops` module docstring); it updates the in-memory
latest-position cache and is fanned out live to every `WS /v1/fleet/live`
subscriber for the caller's tenant.

subscriber_count.title: Subscriber Count
subscriber_count.description: Number of currently-connected WS /v1/fleet/live listeners this update reached (0 is normal — most publishes happen with no dashboard currently watching).

PositionRead.title: PositionRead
PositionRead.description:
Shape of one cached/broadcast position — this is also exactly the JSON
message shape sent over `WS /v1/fleet/live`.

ShiftCreate.title: ShiftCreate
ShiftCreate.description:
Generic create — accepted for CRUD completeness/admin backfill, but the
normal opening path for a shift is `POST /v1/shifts/start` above.

end_at.title: End At
end_at.description: Defaults to server time (UTC now) if omitted.

reconciled.title: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Whether the driver's counted cash matches the recomputed cash_total.

ShiftEnd.title: ShiftEnd
ShiftEnd.description:
Body for `POST /v1/shifts/{id}/end` — reconciliation figures accepted from
the client. `trips_count`/`km_total`/`cash_total`/`card_total` are NOT accepted
here — they are recomputed server-side from the shift's trips.

ShiftReport.title: ShiftReport
ShiftReport.description:
`GET /v1/shifts/{id}/report` payload.

TODO(reporting): this is JSON-only for now. A later pass should add PDF/CSV
export (e.g. weasyprint/reportlab for PDF, stdlib csv for CSV) built on top
of this same summary shape — no PDF library is available in this pass.

start_at.title: Start At
start_at.description: Defaults to server time (UTC now) if omitted.

ShiftStart.title: ShiftStart
ShiftStart.description: Body for `POST /v1/shifts/start` — opens a new shift.

ShiftUpdate.title: ShiftUpdate
ShiftUpdate.description:
Partial update — every field optional. Intended for admin corrections
(e.g. fixing a mis-keyed inspection checklist or reconciliation figure).

SubscriptionCreate.title: SubscriptionCreate
SubscriptionCreate.description:
price_aud/status/stripe_subscription_id are deliberately NOT
client-settable on create — price is always derived server-side from
`plan` (see app.services.billing.price_for_plan) so it can never drift
from the plan actually billed, and status/stripe id come back from the
(mock-fallback) Stripe call.

SubscriptionUpdate.title: SubscriptionUpdate
SubscriptionUpdate.description:
Plan change only. `vehicle_id` is immutable after creation (create a
new subscription for a different vehicle instead); `price_aud` is
re-derived server-side from the new plan, never client-supplied.

TariffUpdate.title: TariffUpdate
TariffUpdate.description:
Partial update — every field optional. `tenant_id` and `region` are not
changeable after creation (region defines which Fares Order reference a
tariff is validated against; create a new tariff instead).

TelemetryPoint.title: TelemetryPoint
TelemetryPoint.description: A single raw GPS/speed fix, as recorded by the in-vehicle meter.

client_uuid.title: Client Uuid
client_uuid.description: Offline idempotency key, unique per tenant

device_total.title: Device Total
device_total.description: The total the offline device computed on-vehicle

TripSyncItem.title: TripSyncItem
TripSyncItem.description:
A complete, self-contained trip payload uploaded after a period offline.

Carries its own `client_uuid` (idempotency key) and the raw `gps_trace`
recorded on-device so the server can independently recompute the fare and
check it against `device_total`.

live_status.title: Live Status
live_status.description: Best-known live status: the last-published position's status if one has ever been published for this vehicle, else 'on_trip' if it has a currently-open trip, else its fleet-domain vehicle_status as a fallback.

position_updated_at.title: Position Updated At
position_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the position lat/lng above — either a live publish or a trip's last tick.

position_source.title: Position Source
position_source.description: 'live' = from a WS/POST position publish; 'trip' = fallback to the open trip's last tick; 'none' = no position known at all.

VehicleLiveRead.title: VehicleLiveRead
VehicleLiveRead.description:
One row of `GET /v1/vehicles` — a Vehicle (owned by the fleet domain)
with its latest known position/status joined in from the live-position
cache, its paired Device (if any), and its currently-open Trip (if any).
Read-only: there is no create/update/delete here, this domain does not own
the `vehicles` table.
